title: eBGP session torn down — max-prefix limit exceeded
symptom: R2-R3 eBGP session establishes briefly then immediately drops to Idle. The pattern repeats on reconnect. Customer has no reachability.

inject.note: R3 advertises 2 prefixes (10.1.0.0/24 and 10.2.0.0/24). With maximum-prefix set to 1, R2 sends a NOTIFICATION and shuts the session as soon as the second prefix arrives.

ground_truth.root_cause: max-prefix limit (1) exceeded on R2 toward 192.0.2.2 — peer advertised 2 prefixes, R2 sent NOTIFICATION and shut down the session
ground_truth.fix: router bgp 65001 / neighbor 192.0.2.2 maximum-prefix 10 (or remove the limit)
ground_truth.verify: show ip bgp neighbors 192.0.2.2 shows Established with correct prefix count
